name: smwmusic-harry-potter-chamber-of-secrets-gba-main-menu
title: Harry Potter: Chamber of Secrets (GBA) - Main Menu
description:
This is a recreation of the main menu theme from Harry Potter: Chamber of Secrets for the Game Boy Advance.

The GBA version's music is almost identical to the GBC version's, despite being different in gameplay. The only difference is that the bass instrument is more realistic, the noise channel of the original Game Boy is no longer used, and the pulse waves are messed up.
